content.user_title: Improve AI Prompts With Proven Patterns
content.value_statement: Weak prompts create inconsistent AI results and wasted review time. This skill gives clear patterns, templates, and testing methods for reliable prompts.
actual_capabilities: Explains few-shot learning with support ticket extraction examples.
Shows structured task decomposition for bug analysis prompts.
Demonstrates prompt iteration with versioned summary prompts and result comparisons.
Provides a reusable Python-style prompt template with variables and checklists.
Defines system prompt components, instruction hierarchy, and error recovery practices.
limitations: Does not run prompt evaluations or collect metrics automatically.
Does not include tool integrations, scripts, or external services.
Does not provide domain-specific safety policies for regulated use cases.
Examples are educational and need adaptation before production use.

use_cases.title: Standardize Support Triage Prompts
use_cases.description: Create consistent prompts that classify support tickets, extract key details, and guide response priority.

use_cases.title: Improve Engineering Agent Reviews
use_cases.description: Design prompts that focus code review agents on security, maintainability, and clear output structure.

use_cases.title: Test Production Prompt Changes
use_cases.description: Compare prompt versions against realistic inputs before shipping assistant behavior changes.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Basic Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this prompt for clarity and consistent output. Goal: [goal]. Current prompt: [prompt]. Return the revised prompt and one short reason.

prompt_templates.title: Create Few-Shot Examples
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three input and output examples for this task: [task]. Use realistic edge cases. Keep the format consistent across examples.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reusable Agent Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable prompt template for [workflow]. Include role, task, input fields, output format, fallback behavior, and test cases.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Agent Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent transcript and identify prompt issues: [transcript]. Separate unclear instructions, missing context, conflicting constraints, and evaluation checks.

output_examples.input: A user starts with: Summarize this report.
output_examples.output: A stronger prompt asks for audience, length, key findings, decision impact, and required exclusions.

output_examples.input: An agent returns inconsistent bug triage recommendations.
output: Add examples for each severity level.
Define the required triage fields in the prompt.
Test the prompt against normal, urgent, and incomplete bug reports.

output_examples.input: A production prompt is accurate but too long.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests testing simpler instructions, removing duplicate examples, and measuring accuracy before reducing constraints.

best_practices: Start with the simplest prompt that can work, then add constraints only when results show a gap.
Test prompts with representative success cases, edge cases, and failure cases before production use.
Version important prompts and document the intent behind each major instruction.
anti_patterns: Adding many examples before defining the task and output format.
Using examples that do not match the real user inputs.
Treating prompt edits as finished without measuring accuracy, consistency, or cost.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps you design, refine, test, and debug prompts for AI assistants and coding agents.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is tool-neutral and applies to Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and similar assistants.

faq.question: Can it create production prompts?
faq.answer: It can draft production-ready structures, but teams should test them with real inputs before release.

faq.question: Does it execute code or call external tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a Markdown guide and does not include scripts, network calls, or external commands.

faq.question: Can it debug poor agent behavior?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps inspect instructions, examples, constraints, and missing evaluation checks.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive data workflows?
faq.answer: It can help structure prompts, but you must add privacy rules and avoid exposing secrets.
